title: Scarab chain tip and ledger
description: Live-tip activity, validation, observed rollbacks, ledger epochs, local mempool and storage. Existing node metrics and retained events; no inferred block contents or unseen branches.

options.content: **At the tip:** watch block application, peer-observed lag, validation latency, fork switches and ChainSync activity. Select one node: Pascal and Ruthie follow different networks. **Lag compares our tip with the last peer tip recorded on an extension**; it is not an independent network clock or a freshness guarantee. Missing values remain missing. Latency quantiles are bucket estimates; read their sample counts, especially at quiet tips. Counter increases are extrapolated and may be fractional. A continuous per-block identity feed, block body bytes, chain transaction counts, producer identities and competing tine geometry are not available through current telemetry. Block hashes are present in sampled extension and rollback logs. Logs retain only one `extended` line per 1,000 blocks. This dashboard does not infer those absent facts.

panels.title: Metrics endpoint reachable
panels.description: Successful scrape does not prove chain freshness.

panels.title: Block lag vs recorded peer
panels.description: Signed difference; negative values can occur because peer observation and tip updates differ.

targets.expr: max by (host, container) (scarab_peer_tip_block{host=~"$host", container=~"$container"}) - max by (host, container) (cardano_node_metrics_blockNum_int{host=~"$host", container=~"$container"})

panels.title: Slot lag vs recorded peer
panels.description: Slots, not seconds. Does not establish time since the last network block.

targets.expr: max by (host, container) (scarab_peer_tip_slot{host=~"$host", container=~"$container"}) - max by (host, container) (cardano_node_metrics_slotNum_int{host=~"$host", container=~"$container"})

panels.title: Current node phase
panels.description: Exactly one phase is active.

panels.title: Current era
panels.description: Most recent extension; may be absent before live following.

panels.title: Running build
panels.description: Series labels carry source commit, version and Scala version.

targets.expr: max by (host, container, git_commit, version, scala_version) (scarab_build_info{host=~"$host", container=~"$container"})

panels.title: Local and peer-observed block heights
panels.description: Comparisons apply only within the selected node/network. Peer gauge updates on extension.

panels.title: Tip differences in blocks and slots
panels.description: Signed differences. Neither a slot ratio nor 100% is proof that we are current.

targets.expr: max by (host, container) (scarab_peer_tip_block{host=~"$host", container=~"$container"}) - max by (host, container) (cardano_node_metrics_blockNum_int{host=~"$host", container=~"$container"})
max by (host, container) (scarab_peer_tip_slot{host=~"$host", container=~"$container"}) - max by (host, container) (cardano_node_metrics_slotNum_int{host=~"$host", container=~"$container"})

panels.title: Applied blocks in selected range
panels.description: All eras combined. Stored replay excluded; this is local application activity.

panels.title: Validation refusals in range
panels.description: Refused blocks by ledger rule. Zero is separate from missing telemetry.

panels.title: Follower stalls in range
panels.description: Watchdog stalls: no extension while a peer announced a longer chain.

panels.title: Blocks applied per minute, by era
panels.description: Local chain extensions, excluding stored replay. A fork switch can reapply blocks; this is not unique network production.

panels.title: Implied interval per applied block
panels.description: Inverse of the rolling local application rate. Empty with no observed application. Catch-up and branch switching differ from steady-tip block arrival.

panels.title: Volatile chain density
panels.description: Blocks per slot from immutable anchor to local tip. A chain-density measure, not block byte utilization or network occupancy.

panels.title: Validation refusals by rule family / hour
panels.description: One-hour rolling count. Inspect error events below for typed failure details.

panels.title: Block validation and application time
panels.description: Successful ledger validation and application only; validation refusals are recorded separately. Not full end-to-end propagation. Quantiles need enough samples and are interpolated within histogram buckets. Values above the largest finite bucket (16.384s) cannot be resolved precisely.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.5, sum by (host, container, le) (rate(scarab_block_apply_seconds_bucket{host=~"$host", container=~"$container"}[$__rate_interval]))) and on (host, container) (sum by (host, container) (rate(scarab_block_apply_seconds_count{host=~"$host", container=~"$container"}[$__rate_interval])) > 0)

histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (host, container, le) (rate(scarab_block_apply_seconds_bucket{host=~"$host", container=~"$container"}[$__rate_interval]))) and on (host, container) (sum by (host, container) (rate(scarab_block_apply_seconds_count{host=~"$host", container=~"$container"}[$__rate_interval])) > 0)

histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by (host, container, le) (rate(scarab_block_apply_seconds_bucket{host=~"$host", container=~"$container"}[$__rate_interval]))) and on (host, container) (sum by (host, container) (rate(scarab_block_apply_seconds_count{host=~"$host", container=~"$container"}[$__rate_interval])) > 0)

panels.title: Block apply samples in rate window
panels.description: Samples behind the adjacent latency panel. Prometheus increase is extrapolated and may be fractional.

panels.title: Block apply cumulative bucket population in window
panels.description: Cumulative counts: the +Inf bucket is the total sample count; series overlap and must not be stacked.

panels.title: Validation worker demand
panels.description: CPU-bound steps on the follower pool, not chain transactions or CPU utilization.

panels.title: ChainSync traffic
panels.description: Aggregate across sessions; duplicate announcements are possible. Received header counter also includes rollbacks.

panels.title: Header gate outcomes / minute
panels.description: Waited headers are an additional observation, not a mutually exclusive third acceptance result.

panels.title: ChainSync round duration — includes waiting
panels.description: From first pipelined request to last reply, including protocol await time. This is not network RTT or block propagation delay; the largest finite bucket is 5 seconds.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (host, container, le) (rate(scarab_chainsync_round_seconds_bucket{host=~"$host", container=~"$container"}[$__rate_interval]))) and on (host, container) (sum by (host, container) (rate(scarab_chainsync_round_seconds_count{host=~"$host", container=~"$container"}[$__rate_interval])) > 0)

panels.title: ChainSync duration samples
panels.description: A quiet tip can have long waiting rounds and sparse completed samples.

panels.title: Genesis state machine
panels.description: One-hot state: PreSyncing, Syncing or CaughtUp.

panels.title: Block fetch mode
panels.description: One-hot BulkSync versus Deadline mode.

panels.title: First-arrival scoreboard occupancy
panels.description: Slots held by bounded header/block first-arrival scoreboards (at most 180 each). No peer scores or first-arrival latencies are exported.

panels.title: Fork switches in range
panels.description: Switches involving at least one rolled-back block. Not a count of all competing branches.

panels.title: Rollback depth observations
panels.description: Read this count before interpreting depth quantiles.

panels.title: Rollback events / hour and depth sum / hour
panels.description: Our observed rollbacks; unseen competitor tines are not represented.

panels.title: Rollback depth
panels.description: Empty with no events in the rate window. Bucket estimates, not exact largest rollback.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (host, container, le) (rate(scarab_rollback_depth_blocks_bucket{host=~"$host", container=~"$container"}[$__rate_interval]))) and on (host, container) (sum by (host, container) (rate(scarab_rollback_depth_blocks_count{host=~"$host", container=~"$container"}[$__rate_interval])) > 0)

panels.title: Rollback and chain-selection event history
panels.description: Available events only. Raw JSON gives points and causes where emitted; absence is not proof no alternative branch existed.

panels.title: Epoch number
panels.description: Current tip epoch, resolved by node genesis geometry.

panels.title: Slot within epoch
panels.description: Tip slot relative to start of epoch. No duration/percentage is inferred because epoch length and slot duration are not exported.

panels.title: UTxO entries at epoch boundary
panels.description: Updated at the start of an epoch; not a per-block live UTxO count. May be absent before this process emits its first ledgerEpoch event.

panels.title: Registered stake credentials at epoch boundary
panels.description: Epoch-refreshed ledger population; not a count of active wallets. May be absent until the first ledgerEpoch event in this process.

panels.title: Registered stake pools at epoch boundary
panels.description: Registered pools, not pools that won a block or produced this epoch. May be absent until the first ledgerEpoch event in this process.

panels.title: Epoch, era and ledger validation events
panels.description: Actual emitted events, without inferring epoch durations or winners.

panels.title: Mempool — local submissions, not chain transaction throughput
Held transaction bytes
panels.description: Serialized mempool transactions; not block body size.

panels.title: Mempool additions and outcomes / minute
panels.description: Counts only transactions held or submitted locally. This cannot measure all transactions in received blocks.

panels.title: Mempool and own-forging event history
panels.description: Only locally submitted/held transactions and our own forging events, when emitted.

panels.title: Immutable blocks
panels.description: Immutable blocks found on open plus subsequently committed blocks.

panels.title: Volatile blocks
panels.description: Blocks retained above immutable anchor, bounded by security parameter k.

panels.title: New immutable blocks / minute
panels.description: Trend of a gauge. Startup/restoration and truncation can distort this estimate.

panels.title: Snapshot problems in range
panels.description: Skipped, Failed and Refused; inspect kind and event detail.

panels.title: Last snapshot write duration
panels.description: Held value of most recent completed write, not a periodic duration sample.

panels.title: Last snapshot bytes
panels.description: Size of latest written snapshot, not total database size.

panels.title: Snapshot problems by kind / hour
panels.description: Skipped unreadable snapshots can fall back to an older snapshot; inspect logs.

panels.title: Startup replay block and target
panels.description: Retained startup values after Following. Progress reports are interval sampled; volatile replay can continue beyond the immutable target.

panels.title: Stored replay blocks at startup
panels.description: Retained total from startup. Elapsed duration is shown separately below.

panels.title: Process restarts visible in range
panels.description: Start-time changes observed by scrapes; a missing interval can hide a restart.

panels.title: Storage, startup and shutdown event history
panels.description: Storage lifecycle events are retained without per-block sampling. Raw details describe migration, restore and any recovery truncation.
